title: Fishing Stand
text: You can place the Fishing Stand on any building with "Classification: Mansion". The Fishing Stand is a craftable furniture item that can only be placed on a 44x44 Mansions. Once placed the Fishing Stand functions similarly to the Fishing Stands found in Erenor, allowing players to sell fish directly to it. Function The Fishing Stand provides a way to sell caught fish directly at a 44x44 Mansion which opens up the possibility of new fishing hot spots to emerge. Can only be placed on a 44x44 Mansion. Allows players to sell eligible fish. Functions like a regular Fishing Stand for fish sales. Can be used by players with access to the mansion. Crafting The recipe can be found in the Folio (O) by searching "Fish Crane" then selecting the recipe it is used for. To make a Fishing Stand you are going to need quite a long list of materials, the recipe requires a large quantity of Lumber, various Ingots, 4x Thunderstruck Trees and also the Fishing Entrepreneur Permit which you can purchase from a General Merchant for 5000g. Quantity Material 1 Fish Crane 4 Mechanical Spring 12 Exquisite Screw 6 Exquisite Wooden Pole 2 Solid Shaft 1 Fishing Entrepreneur Permit

The Fishing Stand is a craftable furniture item that can only be placed on a 44x44 Mansions.

Once placed the Fishing Stand functions similarly to the Fishing Stands found in Erenor, allowing players to sell fish directly to it.

Function

The Fishing Stand provides a way to sell caught fish directly at a 44x44 Mansion which opens up the possibility of new fishing hot spots to emerge.

Can only be placed on a 44x44 Mansion. Allows players to sell eligible fish. Functions like a regular Fishing Stand for fish sales. Can be used by players with access to the mansion.

Crafting

To make a Fishing Stand you are going to need quite a long list of materials, the recipe requires a large quantity of Lumber, various Ingots, 4x Thunderstruck Trees and also the Fishing Entrepreneur Permit which you can purchase from a General Merchant for 5000g.

1 Fish Crane
4 Mechanical Spring
12 Exquisite Screw
6 Exquisite Wooden Pole
2 Solid Shaft
1 Fishing Entrepreneur Permit

= Fishing Stand =
[[File:Archeage kBPKWk5uBT.png|thumb|right|You can place the Fishing Stand on any building with "Classification: Mansion".]]
The '''[https://aa-classic.com/database/item/9002392 Fishing Stand]''' is a craftable furniture item that can only be placed on a 44x44 Mansions.

Once placed the Fishing Stand functions similarly to the Fishing Stands found in Erenor, allowing players to sell fish directly to it.

== Function ==

The Fishing Stand provides a way to sell caught fish directly at a 44x44 Mansion which opens up the possibility of new fishing hot spots to emerge.

Can only be placed on a '''44x44 Mansion'''.
Allows players to sell eligible fish.
Functions like a regular Fishing Stand for fish sales.
Can be used by players with access to the mansion.

== Crafting ==
[[File:Archeage rqR6H29h8M.png|thumb|right|The recipe can be found in the Folio (O) by searching "Fish Crane" then selecting the recipe it is used for.]]
To make a Fishing Stand you are going to need quite a long list of materials, the recipe requires a large quantity of Lumber, various Ingots, 4x Thunderstruck Trees and also the Fishing Entrepreneur Permit which you can purchase from a [[General Merchant]] for 5000g.
